headline: The Union and partners publish report on widening access to inhaled medicines, drawing on insulin lessons
dek: The report from The Union, the Forum of International Respiratory Societies and the NCD Policy Lab sets out five actions to improve access to inhalers for asthma and COPD.
key_quote: If we can improve access to insulin, why can't we do the same for inhaled medicines?

source.author_name: International Union Against Tuberculosis and Lung Disease (The Union)
